eberhard-karls-universitat-tubingen.about:
The University of Tübingen is one of Germany's oldest universities and an Excellence University, central to a small, student-dominated town on the Neckar. It hosts the Cyber Valley AI research ecosystem and Max Planck institutes, and is strong in machine learning, neuroscience, medicine, theology, philosophy and archaeology.

International applicants need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes; as in all of Baden-Württemberg, non-EU/EEA students without a German entrance qualification pay an international tuition fee each semester.
eberhard-karls-universitat-tubingen.aid_intl: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.
eberhard-karls-universitat-tubingen.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
eberhard-karls-universitat-tubingen.gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.
requirements: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

hanyang-university.about:
Hanyang University, founded in 1939, has its main campus in Seoul and the ERICA campus in Ansan. It built its reputation on engineering and architecture and is also strong in business, entrepreneurship, music and performing arts, with many alumni leading Korean companies.

International freshmen apply for March or September entry with school records, a study plan and TOPIK or English scores; scholarships are offered to strong applicants.
hanyang-university.aid_intl: Admission and merit scholarships for international students plus the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS).
hanyang-university.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may support an application). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4+); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.
hanyang-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

hokkaido-university.about:
Hokkaido University began in 1876 as Sapporo Agricultural College under William S. Clark ('Boys, be ambitious!') and has one of Japan's largest campuses in central Sapporo. It is renowned for agriculture, veterinary medicine, fisheries and marine science, environmental science, engineering and Japanese studies.

International students can apply to English-taught bachelor's routes such as the Integrated Science Program and the Modern Japanese Studies Program, or to Japanese-taught degrees via the EJU. Tuition is at the national-university rate.
hokkaido-university.aid_intl: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students.
hokkaido-university.tests: Japanese-taught degrees for privately financed international students require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency, plus university-specific exams/interviews. English-taught undergraduate programmes (where offered) use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency. No SAT/ACT requirement for Japanese-taught tracks.
hokkaido-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Japanese proficiency or English test (English-taught programmes)

humboldt-universitat-zu-berlin.about:
Humboldt University is one of Berlin's three major universities, with its main building on Unter den Linden and science campus in Adlershof; its alumni and faculty include dozens of Nobel laureates. It is strong in history, philosophy, literature, social sciences, law, economics, life sciences and mathematics, and shares the Charité medical school with FU Berlin.

International applicants usually apply via uni-assist and need German C1; there are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution that includes a public-transport ticket.
humboldt-universitat-zu-berlin.aid_intl: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.
humboldt-universitat-zu-berlin.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes

indian-institute-of-science-iisc-bangalo.about:
Founded in 1909 with support from Jamsetji Tata, IISc is India's leading research institution in science and engineering, mostly a graduate school. Since 2011 it has offered a highly selective four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) with majors in physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, materials and earth sciences, and more recently a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing.

Undergraduate admission uses national entrance exams (JEE Main/Advanced, NEET or the IISER Aptitude Test) as announced each year; international applicants should check eligibility with the institute.
indian-institute-of-science-iisc-bangalo.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.
indian-institute-of-science-iisc-bangalo.tests: No SAT/ACT. Admission to the B.S. (Research) and B.Tech (Mathematics and Computing) uses national entrance exam ranks (JEE Main/Advanced, IISER Aptitude Test or NEET as specified each year). Teaching is in English.
indian-institute-of-science-iisc-bangalo.gpa_note: Selection by national entrance exam rank; extremely competitive.
requirements: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

indian-institute-of-technology-bombay-ii.about:
IIT Bombay, founded in 1958 with UNESCO and Soviet support, sits on a lakeside campus in Powai, Mumbai. Its computer science programme attracts India's top JEE rankers, and it is also strong in electrical, aerospace, chemical and mechanical engineering, engineering physics and industrial design.

Undergraduates are admitted through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and take supernumerary seats. Campus life is vibrant, with the Mood Indigo and Techfest festivals.
indian-institute-of-technology-bombay-ii.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.
indian-institute-of-technology-bombay-ii.tests: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.
indian-institute-of-technology-bombay-ii.gpa_note: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.
requirements: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

indian-institute-of-technology-delhi-iit.about:
IIT Delhi, established in 1961, is one of India's premier engineering institutes on a campus in Hauz Khas, south Delhi. It is renowned for computer science, electrical, mechanical and chemical engineering, mathematics and computing, and for a strong startup culture among alumni.

Undergraduate admission is entirely through JEE (Advanced) rank and JoSAA counselling. Foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and compete for supernumerary seats; all teaching is in English.
indian-institute-of-technology-delhi-iit.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

indian-institute-of-technology-kanpur-ii.about:
IIT Kanpur, founded in 1959 with help from a consortium of US universities, pioneered computer science education in India and has its own airstrip for aerospace research. It is strong in computer science, electrical and aerospace engineering, physics, mathematics and economics.

Undergraduate admission is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and take supernumerary seats. All teaching is in English.
indian-institute-of-technology-kanpur-ii.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

indian-institute-of-technology-kharagpur.about:
IIT Kharagpur was the first of the Indian Institutes of Technology, set up in 1951 in a former detention camp at Hijli. Its 2,100-acre campus hosts engineering, architecture, law (Rajiv Gandhi School of IP Law), management, medicine and mining departments, giving it the widest academic range of any IIT.

Undergraduate places are filled through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA counselling; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and compete for supernumerary seats.
indian-institute-of-technology-kharagpur.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

indian-institute-of-technology-madras-ii.about:
IIT Madras, founded in 1959 with West German assistance, has a forested campus in Chennai and the IIT Madras Research Park, a hub for deep-tech startups. It is strong across engineering, computer science, ocean and aerospace engineering, and runs a large online B.S. in Data Science and Applications open to students regardless of JEE.

On-campus B.Tech admission is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA, with foreign nationals able to take JEE (Advanced) directly. The institute has also opened an international campus in Zanzibar.
indian-institute-of-technology-madras-ii.aid_intl: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

keio-university.about:
Founded in 1858 by Fukuzawa Yukichi, Keio University is one of Japan's two most prestigious private universities, with campuses at Mita, Hiyoshi, Shonan Fujisawa (SFC) and Shinanomachi (medicine). It is known for economics, business, law, medicine and policy studies, and its alumni network dominates Japanese business.

For students without Japanese, Keio offers the PEARL programme in the Faculty of Economics and the GIGA programme at SFC, both taught in English with September entry and document-based selection. Japanese-taught faculties use the EJU and faculty exams.
keio-university.aid_intl: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students. Keio offers its own scholarships for international students.
keio-university.tests: English-taught programmes (PEARL in economics, GIGA at Shonan Fujisawa) use document screening with standardized test results (e.g. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) and English proficiency; Japanese-taught programmes require EJU and Japanese proficiency with faculty exams. Exact thresholds are set in each programme's guidelines.
top_programs: GIGA (Environment and Information Studies/Policy Management, English-taught)
keio-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Standardized test results (SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) for English-taught programmes

kyung-hee-university.about:
Kyung Hee University, founded in 1949, has campuses in Seoul and Global Campus in Yongin. It is known for hospitality and tourism management, traditional Korean medicine, international studies, music and dance, and physics, and it has a strong tradition of peace and global engagement.

International applicants apply for March or September entry with school records, a study plan and TOPIK or English scores. Merit scholarships are available.
kyung-hee-university.aid_intl: Admission and merit scholarships for international students plus the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS).
kyung-hee-university.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may support an application). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4+); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.
kyung-hee-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

kyushu-university.about:
Kyushu University, founded in 1911, is the leading research university of western Japan, with its main Ito campus in Fukuoka. It is known for engineering (including hydrogen and energy research), agriculture, medicine, dentistry, economics and design.

International students can enter through English-taught International Undergraduate Programs (e.g. in engineering, agriculture and the School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation) or through Japanese-taught degrees requiring the EJU. Tuition follows the low national-university rate.
kyushu-university.aid_intl: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students.
kyushu-university.tests: Japanese-taught degrees for privately financed international students require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency, plus university-specific exams/interviews. English-taught undergraduate programmes (where offered) use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency. No SAT/ACT requirement for Japanese-taught tracks.
top_programs: International Undergraduate Program in Bioresource and Bioenvironment
kyushu-university.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Japanese proficiency or English test (English-taught programmes)

national-cheng-kung-university-ncku.about:
National Cheng Kung University, founded in 1931, has a large campus in the historic city of Tainan. It is one of Taiwan's top engineering schools (mechanical, civil, electrical, aeronautics and astronautics), with a major medical college and hospital, and strong architecture, urban planning and management programmes.

International students apply online for September entry with academic records, study plans, recommendations and language certificates (TOCFL or TOEFL/IELTS). Costs in Tainan are low, and scholarships are available.
national-cheng-kung-university-ncku.aid_intl: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education/Foreign Affairs) and university scholarships for international degree students.
national-cheng-kung-university-ncku.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).
national-cheng-kung-university-ncku.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

national-tsing-hua-university-nthu.about:
National Tsing Hua University was re-established in Taiwan in 1956 and sits beside the Hsinchu Science Park, home of TSMC. It is known for electrical engineering and semiconductors, materials science, physics, chemistry, nuclear science and computer science, and merged with National Hsinchu University of Education in 2016.

International degree students apply directly for September entry with transcripts, a study plan, recommendations and language proof (TOCFL for Chinese-taught, TOEFL/IELTS for English-taught programmes). Tuition is low by international standards and Taiwan Scholarships are available.
national-tsing-hua-university-nthu.aid_intl: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education/Foreign Affairs) and university scholarships for international degree students.
national-tsing-hua-university-nthu.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).
national-tsing-hua-university-nthu.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
